title: Crestline Credit Card Rates and Interest Terms by Product
content:
Every Crestline Credit Card account carries a variable purchase APR fixed for its product at approval. Interest is figured with a daily periodic rate, the APR divided by 365 days, and when any interest is due in a billing cycle the charge is at least 2.00 USD. No Crestline Credit Card product carries an annual fee.

## Rates table

| Product | Purchase APR | Daily rate basis | Annual fee | Minimum interest charge | Foreign transaction fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | 32.99% | 365 days | 0 USD | 2.00 USD | 0% |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | 30.99% | 365 days | 0 USD | 2.00 USD | 0% |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | 29.49% | 365 days | 0 USD | 2.00 USD | 0% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 29.99% | 365 days | 0 USD | 2.00 USD | 3% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 27.74% | 365 days | 0 USD | 2.00 USD | 3% |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 24.99% | 365 days | 0 USD | 2.00 USD | 0% |

## Terms explained

- **Purchase APR** is the standard variable rate assigned when Northgate approves the account.
- **Daily periodic rate** is the purchase APR divided by 365. Example on hypothetical figures: an APR of 24.99% gives a daily rate of 24.99 divided by 365, about 0.0685 percent a day.
- **Minimum interest charge** applies only in a cycle in which some interest is due; a cycle with no interest due carries no charge.
- **Foreign transaction fee** applies to a purchase made in a foreign currency or processed outside the US. It is 3% on the Crestline Auto Care Mastercard and the Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred and 0% on every other product (the private-label products are accepted at Crestline stores only).

Hypothetical illustration: a cycle in which the interest worked out comes to 0.85 USD is charged 2.00 USD; a cycle in which it comes to 6.40 USD is charged 6.40 USD.
